en.feed.recoFallback: Rate a few more stories and this feed gets sharper — showing the freshest for now.
en.onboard.title: Teach Meridian your taste
en.onboard.hint: Like or skip a few stories. Your preferences stay on this device.
en.onboard.empty: Stories are still loading — try again in a moment.
en.battle.hint: One story, every angle — drag the bubbles
en.battle.empty: Not enough overlapping coverage right now — check back after the next refresh.
en.battle.error: The battle view could not be loaded.
en.lang.title: Translation
en.lang.hint: Runs on your device when the browser supports it; otherwise a free server fallback.
en.lang.pick: Choose a target language other than English first.
en.settings.title: Settings
en.settings.languageHint: One setting for everything: stories are translated into it (on your device when the browser can, otherwise a free server fallback), the AI brief and forecast answer in it, and the interface follows wherever a translation of the interface exists — English only so far.
en.settings.sourcesHint: Switch a source off to hide its stories from the feed.
en.settings.sourcesError: Sources could not be loaded. Close and reopen settings to retry.
en.settings.aboutText: Meridian is an open-source news reader that aggregates dozens of verified feeds and sorts the world by freshness. The world, as it happens.
en.brief.label: BRIEF
en.brief.error: The brief could not be built — it will retry with the next batch of stories.
en.brief.empty: Nothing to summarize yet — the feed is still loading.
en.forecast.label: AHEAD · AI FORECAST · 7 DAYS
en.forecast.disclaimer: Possible events an AI model on this device extrapolated from the stories in view — not news, not reporting, not verified. Read them as things to watch, nothing more.
en.forecast.expand: Show why the model expects this
en.forecast.tooFew: Not enough English stories in this view to forecast from — try the All tab.
en.forecast.error: The forecast could not be generated. Try again.
en.forecast.abstract: The model only restated the news this time — try again for a sharper set.
en.forecast.needsGesture: The model still needs a one-time download — press Enable to start it.
en.settings.forecastToggle: Pull down at the top of the feed for an AI forecast
en.settings.forecastHint: Runs entirely on this device with Chrome’s built-in model. Shown only where the browser supports it.
en.feed.emptyHint: Sources refresh every few minutes — check back shortly.
en.feed.emptySearchHint: Try a different word, or clear the search.
en.feed.emptySavedHint: Tap the bookmark on any story to keep it here — saved stories work offline.
en.feed.error: The feed could not be loaded.
en.feed.errorHint: Check your connection and try again.
en.feed.loadMoreError: More stories could not be loaded.
en.feed.offline: You’re offline — showing stories already loaded.
en.modal.unavailable: Full text unavailable — read at source.
en.comments.title: COMMENTS
en.comments.placeholder: Share your take — you stay anonymous
en.comments.empty: No comments yet — start the conversation.
en.comments.closed: Comments are closed for archived stories.
en.comments.tooFast: Easy there — wait a few seconds between comments.
en.comments.limit: Comment limit reached for this story.
en.comments.failed: Could not post your comment. Try again.
en.card.voteFailed: Could not register your vote. Try again.
en.card.voteClosed: Voting is closed for archived stories.
en.about.blurb: Meridian is a free, open-source world news feed: 83 sources in 8 languages, one stream sorted by freshness, translated and summarized by AI on your own device. No ads, no accounts, no tracking — ever.
en.foot.tagline: MERIDIAN — OPEN SOURCE · NO ADS · NO TRACKING
